macros.name: spellinghighlightcolor
macros.doc: The colour used for highlighting bad spellings can be determined by command \spellinghighlightcolor.

macros.name: spellingmapping
macros.doc: Additional mappings can be declared by command \spellingmapping.

macros.name: spellingoutputname
macros.doc: Text output file name can be configured via command \spellingoutputname.

macros.name: spellingreadbad
macros.doc: Users can load additional files containing lists of bad or good spellings with macros \spellingreadbad and \spellingreadgood.

macros.name: spellingreadgood
macros.doc: Users can load additional files containing lists of bad or good spellings with macros \spellingreadbad and \spellingreadgood.

macros.name: spellingreadLT
macros.doc: Additional LanguageTool xml error reports can be loaded via the \spellingreadLT command.
